title: Jet-consistency prior v2.1: field-normal residual on 2DGS surfels, TOSCA cat0 renders: normals, shell, coverage, collapse, downstream Laplace-Beltrami accuracy
question: On flat 2DGS primitives, does a normal residual measured against the splat field (sheet-PCA tensor at the density-weighted centroid, frozen h0, fixed radius, teacher guard, from the end of densification) improve surfel normals without moving centres, losing coverage or collapsing; is the centre-depth consistency anchor necessary for it; does the centre term add or shrink (ablation); and does it improve the SplatDiffuseLBO operator against the mesh P2 reference?
hypothesis: jet beats b2 in every paired seed: normal-angle median lower by >= 3 deg (target < 7 deg) and normal p90 lower; centre median (bbox-diagonal fraction) and mesh-area coverage no worse; collapse fraction within b2 + 1 percentage point in every seed; held-out PSNR within -0.3 dB. b2_noanchor normals worse than b2 by >= 3 deg in every seed; jet_noanchor normals as good as jet but centres not better than b2_noanchor; jet_c centres move inward with coverage not better than jet; operator max_{k<=10} error on jet below b2 (seed 9561).
claim_boundary: Development screen on one synthetic object (TOSCA cat0 renders), three paired seeds, one lambda; pilot exposure (implementation smokes, a lambda_d diagnostic and the teacher check on b2 seed 9561) is disclosed; a pass is a screening signal requiring a separately registered real-capture confirmation (Janelle / Karate); no default promotion.

datasets.source: ~/Dropbox/Work/Datasets/obj/tosca_hires/cat0.obj + per-vertex colours from cat0_colored_v1.ply, copied to dataset/external/tosca_cat0/source/ (PROVENANCE.json); rendered by scripts/experiments/prepare_tosca_cat0.py (render_receipt.json). views/manifest.json is a plain view list: this RGB-only scene has no compact 2D Gaussian fields; the contract binds it in the data seal.

stages.label: Prepare
stages.purpose: Verify the sealed v1 renders (160 pyrender views) and compute object bounds from the 128 training cameras and masks (v1 code path).

stages.label: Initialization
stages.purpose: The v1 seeded random initialization (20000 points), byte-identical to the v1 run's digests; its bbox diagonal must equal the frozen scene scale.

stages.label: 2DGS fitting
stages.purpose: gsplat rasterization_2dgs surfels, identical Trainer configuration per arm; arms differ only in the anchor weight and the field-prior weight/terms, all of which switch on at step 7500, so every arm of a seed shares the schedule up to the h0 freeze. 15000 steps, densification 500-7500, SH 1, masks on. Displacement and gradient magnitudes, guarded fraction and collapse at activation logged.

stages.label: Evaluation
stages.purpose: Held-out PSNR/LPIPS/silhouette IoU (2DGS render); geometry against cat0.obj in fixed units for the opacity > 0.3 final subset and the frozen step-7500 cohort; coverage; signed displacement; collapse; flatness; splat-frame export; Zhou-Laehner spectrum. The SplatDiffuseLBO operator is the separate sequential operator stage.

comparators.label: 2DGS + distortion (0.01 D/s) + centre-depth consistency 0.05 from 7500, lambda_jet = 0
2DGS + distortion only, lambda_jet = 0
comparators.purpose: What the anchor does alone (vs b2).

comparators.label: b2 + field prior, normal term, lambda_jet 0.1
b2_noanchor + field prior, normal term, lambda_jet 0.1
comparators.purpose: Is the anchor necessary for the prior?

comparators.label: jet + centre term (normal+centre), seed 9561
comparators.purpose: Descriptive ablation of the centre term (expected inward shrinkage).

primary_metrics.label: Surfel normal vs mesh normal, median
primary_metrics.aggregation: Final model, opacity > 0.3, surfel normal (third rotation axis, the -inf scale) vs face normal at the closest point of cat0.obj (trimesh), unoriented.

primary_metrics.label: Surfel normal vs mesh normal, 90 %
primary_metrics.aggregation: As the median; part of the verdict.

primary_metrics.label: Centre-to-surface distance, median
primary_metrics.aggregation: Opacity > 0.3 final subset, closest-point distance in mesh units / bbox diagonal 223.537 (fixed units; the gate).

primary_metrics.label: Mesh-area coverage
primary_metrics.aggregation: Fraction of 20000 area-sampled cat0.obj points (trimesh sample_surface, seed = the cell seed) with an opacity > 0.3 final centre within 0.5 h0-bar; h0-bar = mean frozen h0 over the step-7500 cohort.

primary_metrics.label: Collapse fraction (hard gate, any seed)
primary_metrics.aggregation: Share of all final splats with another splat closer than 0.05 h0_i; h0_i = mean distance to the 6 nearest centres at step 7500, identical rule in every arm. Also reported at activation (step 7500).

primary_metrics.label: SplatDiffuseLBO operator max_{k<=10} |lambda_k/lambda_k^P2 - 1|
primary_metrics.aggregation: b2 and jet, seed 9561, sequential CPU stage after the screen (8 h total): CAT_PLY=<cell>/gaussians_splat_frame.ply CAT_TAG=<task>/<arm>_9561 CAT_GUARD_MIN=<min(240, remaining)> python splat_lbo_cat.py v2 a; counts only if the companion's structural diagnostics pass (operator_stage.structural_limits).

secondary_metrics.label: Held-out PSNR inside mask
secondary_metrics.aggregation: 32 held-out views at 512x512, 2DGS render over white, squared error inside the depth mask; mean over views. Gates the decision (>= -0.3 dB vs b2, about 7 % MSE, an engineering tolerance).

secondary_metrics.label: Held-out LPIPS (AlexNet) on the masked crop
secondary_metrics.aggregation: Mask-weighted crop (8 px margin), mean over views.

secondary_metrics.label: Held-out silhouette IoU
secondary_metrics.aggregation: Rendered alpha > 0.5 vs mask > 0.5, mean over the 32 held-out views.

secondary_metrics.label: Centre-to-surface median / h0-bar
secondary_metrics.aggregation: Median closest-point distance (mesh units) of the opacity > 0.3 final subset divided by h0-bar (mean frozen h0 over the step-7500 cohort); only to mark the PREREG's h-bar-unit prediction, not a gate.

secondary_metrics.label: Signed normal displacement, median
secondary_metrics.aggregation: (c - p) . n_face at the closest point, opacity > 0.3 subset; negative = inside the outward-oriented mesh. inward_fraction = share with negative sign.

secondary_metrics.label: Frozen-cohort normal angle median (and p90, centre median)
secondary_metrics.aggregation: The splats with opacity > 0.3 at step 7500 (identities fixed, topology frozen), evaluated in the final model; counts n_subset, n_cohort and their overlap reported.

secondary_metrics.label: Flatness max sigma_min / sigma_mid
secondary_metrics.aggregation: Over all final splats; must be exactly 0 (backend check).

secondary_metrics.label: Zhou-Laehner max_{k<=10} |lambda_k/lambda_k^P2 - 1|
secondary_metrics.aggregation: robust_laplacian defaults on the subset centres in the splat frame, vs data/cat_reference.npz lam_p2 (v1 evaluator).

decision_policy.per_arm: Pass iff for every paired seed: b2 normal median - jet normal median >= 3 deg, jet normal p90 < b2 normal p90, jet centre median (bbox-diagonal fraction) <= b2's, jet coverage >= b2's, jet collapse fraction <= b2's + 0.01, jet held-out PSNR >= b2 - 0.3 dB. Reject iff jet loses on the normal median in every seed or fails the collapse gate in every seed. Else inconclusive. Collapse gate any-seed: one seed above b2 + 1 point fails the arm regardless of its other metrics. (b) b2_noanchor vs b2, jet_noanchor vs jet and vs b2_noanchor, and the jet_c ablation are descriptive; collapse controls jet_noanchor -> b2_noanchor, jet_c -> b2.
decision_policy.predictions: As stated in the PREREG v2.1: b2 normals 8-14 deg, centre 0.3-0.6 h-bar (marked with centre_distance_over_hbar0_median), flatness 0; b2_noanchor normals worse than b2 by >= 3 deg every seed; jet normal median < 7 deg and >= 3 deg below b2, centre <= b2, gate passed, PSNR within -0.3 dB every seed; jet_noanchor normals as good as jet but centre not better than b2_noanchor; jet_c centres inward (signed displacement negative) at ears and paws, coverage not better than jet; operator jet < b2 (seed 9561). Each is marked right/wrong in the RESULT.
decision_policy.consequence: No default promotion; a real-capture confirmation is a separate registration.
decision_policy.stopping: Fixed steps; abort a cell on non-finite loss, CUDA OOM, a finite third scale (backend check) or a splat-count change after the h0 freeze. Go/no-go before the screen: the teacher check (teacher_check).

coverage.radius: 0.5 h0-bar (mean frozen h0 over the step-7500 cohort)

scene_scale.definition: bbox diagonal of the sealed initialization centres (mesh units); divides gsplat's raw-depth distortion

teacher_check.model: b2 seed 9561 at step 7500 (the frozen schedule stopped at the h0 freeze; schedule_iterations 15000)
teacher_check.compare: angle to the mesh normal of the trained nu_i and of the FieldPrior field normal n_i (same h0, pairs, weights, guard), opacity > 0.3 splats the guard lets through; guarded fractions reported
teacher_check.go: median(n) < median(nu) - 3 deg and p90(n) <= p90(nu); otherwise the screen is not run and the teacher check is the result

declared_behaviour.opacity_reset: gsplat 1.5.3 DefaultStrategy never executes its opacity reset (chained comparison, see src/rtgs/optim/strategies.py); reset_every still pauses refinement and gates large-scale pruning. Shared by every arm; not fixed.
declared_behaviour.centre_depth_anchor: gsplat composites per-surfel centre depth; the normal-consistency term is a centre-depth consistency proxy. Its tilted-plane bias on tiled sheets is reported in the review packet.
declared_behaviour.learning_rates: means LR decays exponentially to 1 % at step 15000 (about 10 % at mid-run) while the quaternion LR is constant; means/quats displacement and gradient magnitudes are logged every 500 steps.
declared_behaviour.third_scale: pinned to -inf by the trainer for gsplat-2dgs (flat surfels through densification and export).

resource_protocol.scope: Fresh process per fitting cell including loading and final save; one GPU job at a time; no fitting cell starts while a companion CPU job (splat_lbo_cat) runs; the operator stage runs after every GPU cell, one model at a time, 8 h CPU total. Descriptive only.
resource_protocol.aggregation: All seeds retained; no speed inference.

operator_stage.command: CAT_PLY=<run>/cells/<arm>/9561/gaussians_splat_frame.ply CAT_TAG=<task_id>/<arm>_9561 CAT_GUARD_MIN=<min(240, remaining budget)> ~/miniconda3/bin/python3.12 splat_lbo_cat.py v2 a (cwd ~/Documents/SplatDiffuseLBO); v2 a deliberately: the operator sees the trained normals

structural_limits.rule: all G15a gate lines PASS, one connected component, exactly one zero mode, cond(M) < 1e10, min n90 over k = 1..30 > 50; otherwise lbo_err_k10 is null (the raw value is kept as lbo_err_k10_raw)

operator_stage.order: After every fitting cell and the evaluate stage; sequential, no GPU cell concurrently; then publish again. Timeout is recorded, not a failure of the screen.
operator_stage.companion_change: splat_lbo_cat.py reads its per-case guard from CAT_GUARD_MIN (default 90 min, unchanged); no other companion change.

initialization.random: 20000 points uniform in the ball of radius 0.5 x extent about the object-bound centre (rtgs.data.calibrated._object_bounds of the 128 training cameras and masks), float64 draws from the paired seed, isotropic scale = mean nearest-neighbour distance, opacity 0.1, colour 0.5 grey; byte-identical across the cells of a seed.

configs.b2: 15000 steps, gsplat-default densification 500-7500 every 100 (grad 2e-4 on gsplat's gradient_2dgs, no absgrad, max 100000, opacity reset 3000 declared inert), SH degree 1 (interval 1000), masks on, random background, ssim 0.2; rasterizer gsplat-2dgs (third log-scale pinned to -inf); depth distortion 0.01 * D / s from step 3000 (s = scene_scale); centre-depth consistency 0.05 from step 7500; lambda_jet 0
configs.jet: b2 with the field prior, normal term, lambda_jet 0.1 from step 7500
configs.jet_noanchor: b2_noanchor with the field prior, normal term, lambda_jet 0.1 from step 7500

training.surfel_regularization: rtgs.render.gsplat_2dgs_backend.SurfelRegularization(depth_distortion, normal_consistency, distortion_start, normal_start, depth_scale=scene_scale[seed]) passed to Trainer.train(surfel_regularization=...): distortion = mean over pixels of gsplat's render_distort (L1 sum_ij w_i w_j |z_i - z_j| in camera depth, mesh units) divided by s; centre-depth consistency = mean over pixels of 1 - n_rendered . (n_from_expected_centre_depth * alpha.detach()); active for step > start.
training.field_prior: rtgs.optim.jet_prior.FieldPrior(weight, start=7500, terms, refresh_every=50, radius=3.0, bandwidth=1.5, n_bandwidth=6, min_gap=0.1, min_support=4.0, log_every=500) passed as Trainer.train(jet_prior=...): h0_i = mean distance to the 6 nearest centres at the first active step (frozen); pairs |c_j - c_i| < 3 h0_i, self included, refreshed every 50 steps; g_ij = exp(-|c_j - c_i|^2 / 2 (1.5 h0_i)^2); rho_j = sum_k g_jk; a_ij = (opacity_j / rho_j) g_ij; m_i = sum_j a_ij c_j / sum_j a_ij; C_i = sum_j a_ij (Sigma_j + (c_j - m_i)(c_j - m_i)^T); n_i = smallest eigenvector; guard: (l2 - l1)/l3 >= 0.1 and sum_j a_ij / max_j a_ij >= 4, else the residual is 0; r_nu = 1 - (nu_i . n_i)^2; r_c = ((c_i - m_i) . n_i)^2 / h0_i^2 (jet_c only); loss lambda_jet * mean over all splats; n_i, m_i detached; gradients into quats_i (r_nu) and means_i (r_c).
training.other: Exact Trainer values in resolved_training_configs (identical across arms except seed); the 2DGS terms in surfel_regularization_configs (+ scene_scale); the prior in field_prior_configs.

scoring.evaluation_render: gsplat rasterization_2dgs, unpacked, full 512x512 held-out cameras, white background.
scoring.geometry: Fixed-unit geometry, coverage, signed displacement and the frozen cohort in the v2.1 driver (mesh_geometry); splat-frame export and Zhou-Laehner via scripts/experiments/eval_jet_prior_tosca_cat0.py (v1 evaluator).
scoring.selection: Final models only; no held-out selection.

execution_controls.rng_policy: After warmup, seed Python random, NumPy, torch CPU and all CUDA generators with the paired seed; CUDA bitwise determinism is not assumed.

source_lifecycle: init-run is official if the owner commits the v1 and v2 implementation before it (clean worktree); otherwise it is a --development run on a dirty worktree. Either way the coordinator archives the exact bound source before the first worker; no source mutation during execution.
